findings.detail: Both locked receipts were independently re-audited: 56 evidence items and 34 section bindings resolve with exact unit, lineage, fidelity and note-section hashes; 7 obligation bindings cite only reviewed BINDING SRC-0010 operative units.
All substantive sections of the six proposed notes carry exactly one reviewed evidence binding; navigation-only and Source References sections remain exempt by contract.
valid_from and valid_until are null on all 56 evidence items; currency against current law, amendments and the pending Digital Omnibus was not verified.
Fidelity inputs are local pypdf token-coverage comparisons; token agreement establishes file consistency only and does not establish layout fidelity or legal correctness.

The data-subject-access-requests Governance Considerations recommendation is bound to the Article 15 core; AI-artifact search-scope and routing remain hedged practice inferences. Navigation summaries retain their receipt-level bounded-support warnings.
SRC-0021 units remain excluded from the receipts pending human or approved vision review and are not silently treated as resolved evidence.
